CreateParameterTemplate.name: Template name. Format: uppercase/lowercase letters, digits, Chinese characters, and special characters -_/. ; must start with a letter or Chinese character; length 1-65
CreateParameterTemplate.parameters: Parameter list; data within the system template, related to the engine and engine version
CreateParameterTemplate.parameters.confName: Parameter name (refer to the system template)
CreateParameterTemplate.parameters.confValue: Parameter value (the value can be modified within the allowed range specified in confRange of the system template)
CreateParameterTemplate.parameters.confType: Parameter type (refer to the system template)
